meta.expansion: trinary (-1, 0, +1) non-parametric intelligence without LLMs, reasoning by derivation over explicit trinary substrate, shipping knowledge as portable .tarchi package
meta.archaion_meaning: Intelligence From The Beginning — derivation from foundational axioms rather than interpolation from a corpus
meta.meaning_of_true: Trinary truth values: -1 false, 0 unknown, +1 true, applied across multiple orthogonal layers (proposition, node, edge)

origin_context.prior_art_summary: Python prototype frozen as binary/float control group for A/B testing, bug at learning.py:211 fixed, will be upgraded to consume .tarchi packages

glossary.Tridak: Base-3 balanced digit {-1,0,+1}, atomic load/offload unit for TArchI
glossary.Balradix: Numeral family: base-3 (Tridak) for atomic ops, base-10 (Baldec) for higher-level encoding, enables sign-free arithmetic
glossary.Baldec: Base-10 balanced digit {-5..+5}, used for strength graduation and promotion in curriculum
glossary.Nubit: Generalization of chess pieces: projects ALL legal successor states of a state at once with polarity and confidence
glossary.Astra: Verifiable capability of 27B-param reference LLM, measured on knowledge-recall AND derivation suites
glossary.rubik_layer: Deterministic verifier: closed finite group action, illegal states unrepresentable, zero hallucination by construction
glossary.chess_layer: Adversarial planner: branching, value-estimating, maps to Nubit generalization
glossary.curriculum: Knowledge acquisition pipeline replacing gradient descent: corpus -> template extraction -> canonicalization -> verification -> rule induction -> promotion -> decay/quarantine
glossary.substrate: The explicit trinary knowledge representation containing axioms, rules, and facts at multiple layers
glossary.four_trit_roles: Orthogonal trinary roles across layers: Truth (proposition), Polarity (edge), Epistemic (ledger), Balance (node charge)
glossary.node_27_states: Combinations of (truth, epistemic, balance) = 27 distinct node states with deterministic lifecycle mapping
glossary.realizer: Trait adapter that constructs answers from resolved substrate plus derivation paths for generation
glossary.tarchi_package: .tarchi format: knowledge package with 4KiB mmap-able pages, Balradix-coded page table, two-tier integrity, composable and delta-updatable

decisions.question: Should TArchI be a standalone project at /home/fola/tarchi or part of oracule-core rewrite?

options.label: Standalone
options.description: New project at /home/fola/tarchi, separate git repo

decisions.answer: Established TArchI as independent project at /home/fola/tarchi
decisions.rationale: Clean separation enables focused development and independent benchmarking from oracule-core prototype

decisions.question: How should trinary values be structured across different abstraction levels?

options.label: Three-layer approach
options.description: Truth at proposition, node triune, edge polarity levels

decisions.answer: Implemented three-level trinary layering simultaneously
decisions.rationale: Enables comprehensive knowledge representation across different abstraction levels

decisions.question: What are the fundamental trinary roles needed for comprehensive intelligence?

options.label: Four orthogonal roles
options.description: Truth, Polarity, Epistemic, Balance across different layers

decisions.answer: Defined four orthogonal trinary roles across four layers
decisions.rationale: Enables nuanced representation of truth, relationships, confidence, and stability

decisions.question: Should TArchI be self-contained or a router to other models?

options.label: Complete stack
options.description: End-to-end intelligence from perception to action

decisions.answer: Built complete self-contained intelligence stack
decisions.rationale: No external dependencies, full autonomy, enables unique capabilities and benchmarking

decisions.question: How should intelligence be derived — from axioms or from data?

options.label: Axiomatic derivation
options.description: From foundational axioms and logical derivation

decisions.answer: Adopted Archaion: Intelligence From The Beginning
decisions.rationale: Ensures traceable, verifiable reasoning with no hallucination

decisions.question: How should development scope be managed — fixed upfront or staged?
decisions.answer: Implemented staged development with M0-M7 milestones
decisions.rationale: Manageable development with regular validation points and flexibility for scope adjustment

decisions.question: What runtime and language should power TArchI?
decisions.answer: Rust core with Python research bindings
decisions.rationale: Rust provides no_std, SIMD, Android NDK, WASM targets; Python enables research while maintaining performance constraints

decisions.question: What numeral system should power TArchI arithmetic?

options.label: Balanced radix (Balradix)
options.description: Tridak (base-3) and Baldec (base-10) for sign-free arithmetic

decisions.answer: Adopted Balradix family: Tridak (base-3) and Baldec (base-10)
decisions.rationale: Eliminates sign bits, enables efficient negation, intuitive for decimal-familiar users

decisions.question: What reference implementation should TArchI use for A/B testing?

options.label: Fixed oracule-core
options.description: Frozen Python prototype with known bug fixed

decisions.answer: Use oracule-core as frozen binary/float control group
decisions.rationale: Direct performance comparison, bug provides improvement opportunity, enables validation

decisions.question: How should answers be generated without LLMs?

options.label: Constructive reasoning
options.description: Realizer trait adapter from substrate + derivation

decisions.answer: Constructive generation via Realizer trait adapter
decisions.rationale: No LLMs anywhere in system, ensures precise, factual, cited responses

decisions.question: How should knowledge be acquired and maintained?

options.label: Curriculum pipeline
options.description: Corpus -> extraction -> verification -> induction -> promotion -> decay

decisions.answer: Implemented curriculum-based learning pipeline
decisions.rationale: No training step, continuous GPU-free learning, single-fact correction, verifiable facts only

decisions.question: What scope should v0.1 target for initial release?

options.label: Closed-domain
options.description: RESOLVE + EXPLAIN + CITE over curated domains

decisions.answer: v0.1 scope: closed-domain RESOLVE + EXPLAIN + CITE
decisions.rationale: Comparable to binary control, high precision requirement, smaller implementation, clear metrics

decisions.question: What schema induction should v0.1 include?

options.label: Minimal schema mining
options.description: Only minimal instead of full ILP

decisions.answer: v0.1 ships with minimal schema mining, not full ILP
decisions.rationale: Schema compression enables 10x size target, easier implementation

decisions.question: What knowledge source should v0.1 use?
decisions.answer: v0.1 knowledge: curated corpus + ground truth
decisions.rationale: Measurable extraction quality and citation coverage, high-quality initial facts

decisions.question: What format should knowledge packaging use?
decisions.answer: .tarchi package: memory-mapped pages with Balradix tables
decisions.rationale: Efficient memory usage, sub-byte addressing, two-tier integrity, composable

decisions.question: How should 1 Astra be defined?

options.label: Verifiable capability
options.description: 27B LLM capability on both recall AND derivation

decisions.answer: 1 Astra: verifiable 27B LLM capability on both knowledge-recall AND derivation
decisions.rationale: Prevents database-only solutions, enables comprehensive intelligence comparison

decisions.question: What efficiency targets should TArchI achieve?
decisions.answer: Target 1.35GB for 1 Astra (vs 13.5GB reference), 2GB RAM, <=1.5 bytes/fact
decisions.rationale: 10x storage reduction enables practical deployment on consumer devices

decisions.question: How should TArchI be validated?
decisions.answer: Native metrics + A/B testing against binary implementations
decisions.rationale: Comprehensive validation with direct comparison capability

decisions.question: How should reasoning and planning be structured?

options.label: Verification + Planning layers
options.description: Rubik for verification, Chess for planning

decisions.answer: Two layers: Rubik (verification) and Chess (planning) with Nubits generalization
decisions.rationale: Deterministic verification + adversarial planning, comprehensive state exploration

decisions.question: How should perception work without LLMs?
decisions.answer: Classical NLP perception pipeline with language server ground truth
decisions.rationale: Precise extraction with verifiable results, no hallucination

honest_limits: Traded open-domain recall and fuzzy similarity for verifiability/density/updateability/footprint (right trade for a 2 GB phone: you cannot ship a corpus but you can ship a compressed, verified, paged theory)
LLM weights carry implicit generalities no fact table expresses, so the 10x claim holds for schema-heavy curated verified knowledge only
Without an LLM realizer the language is precise and cited but not charming
Extraction recall on prose is the weakest link
If derivation parity against a 27B reference fails, split the Astra unit into knowledge-Astra and reasoning-Astra rather than overstate
